prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a production sprite strip for American Girl Doll Race. Image 1 is Hermione's approved identity reference: copy her smooth molded vinyl doll face, brown inset eyes, chunky 18-inch play-doll proportions, bushy chestnut-brown wavy hair, plain white collared shirt, charcoal button cardigan, grey pleated skirt, dark grey knee socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Image 2 is the game's existing Lily sprite sheet: reference for pose staging and the toy-catalog aesthetic ONLY. Do not copy Lily's identity or clothes. Keep Hermione's identity and outfit exactly consistent in all frames. Single horizontal strip of EXACTLY THREE equal square cells, 3:1 aspect ratio. One complete doll in each cell, fully inside its cell with generous clear margin around hair, hands and shoes. No overlapping cells, no labels, no grid lines. Facing right in a slight three-quarter view whenever moving. Simple clear manufactured doll hands, realistic sewn miniature fabrics, soft even studio lighting. Transparent background with clean cutout edges; absolutely no backdrop, gradient, vignette, glow, ground or shadows. For these race animations put her wand away: empty hands. The three cells are idle animation: cell 1 relaxed neutral standing, both feet grounded and hands relaxed; cell 2 slight breathing shift of shoulders and head, both feet grounded; cell 3 gentle weight shift and a hand resting on hip, both feet grounded. Match the first row of Lily's sheet in purpose. Same body size, head height and foot baseline in all three cells.
prompts.run: Edit this three-cell running sprite strip of the Hermione doll. Preserve the exact doll identity, outfit, hair, rendering, full body scale, 3:1 strip layout, three equal square cells, and transparent background. Improve the animation: keep the LEFT frame's long stride; keep the MIDDLE frame's passing legs; change the RIGHT frame to the OPPOSITE running stride, with her near leg kicked backwards bent at knee and the far leg reaching forward to the right, near arm bent forwards and far arm swung backwards. RIGHT frame must be visibly distinct from LEFT, not a repeated pose. All face and travel directions stay RIGHT, not mirrored to left. Give all three a slightly focused determined expression, subtle concentration in brows and small confident smile, like a clever competitive Hermione. No wand, no text, no scenery, no cropping.
prompts.jump: Production sprite strip for American Girl Doll Race. Image 1 is the approved Hermione identity; image 2 is the existing Lily sheet for pose staging only. Keep Hermione's smooth molded vinyl face, brown inset eyes, chunky play-doll proportions, bushy chestnut wavy hair, white collared shirt, charcoal button cardigan, grey pleated skirt, dark knee socks and black Mary Jane shoes identical. EXACTLY THREE equal square cells in one 3:1 horizontal row, one whole doll per cell, ample margin, no cropping/overlap/grid/text. Three-quarter facing RIGHT. Empty hands, wand put away during sports. Soft toy catalog lighting. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, clean alpha cutouts, no gradients, shadows, vignette, floor or halo. Maintain a consistent anatomical scale, especially head size, across cells. Three phases of Hermione jumping: 1 focused crouched takeoff, knees bent, hands near knees, alert determined expression; 2 confident airborne apex with both arms up, legs tucked, delighted proud smile; 3 controlled landing crouch with hands lowered, concentrating on sticking the landing. Her personality is studious, capable and quietly competitive, not a goofy generic character. Same purposes as third row of Lily sheet.
prompts.waveAndCheerAndRide: Create a production 3-cell horizontal sprite strip, three equal square cells in one 3:1 row. The reference is Hermione's approved play-doll identity. Preserve exactly her smooth rounded molded vinyl face, brown inset eyes, chunky doll proportions, bushy chestnut-brown wavy rooted hair, white collared shirt, charcoal button cardigan, grey pleated skirt, dark knee socks and black Mary Jane shoes. All dolls fully inside their cells with ample clear margin, same anatomical scale, no cropping. Three personality poses: LEFT a warm self-assured little wave with right hand, head tilted slightly, friendly thoughtful smile; MIDDLE a proud 'I did it!' cheer, chin lifted, both arms raised in a happy confident V, feet standing on ground; RIGHT calm competent riding pose seated facing slightly right, hands held forwards for reins, knees bent and feet forward/down, no mount, no saddle or reins. Empty hands, wand put away. Premium realistic 18-inch play-doll product illustration, matching the same toy collection, soft even studio lighting. True transparent background, clean cutout alpha, NO vignette, halo, gradient, floor, shadows, lettering, badges or logos.
prompts.push: Generate ONE full-body sprite of the Hermione play doll in the reference, in the purposeful PUSH pose from the middle of the strip. Exact same bushy chestnut hair, brown eyes, rounded molded vinyl doll face, charcoal button cardigan, white collar and cuffs, grey pleated skirt, grey knee socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Facing RIGHT three-quarter view, leaning forwards with both arms extended palms outward and rear leg braced far back, determined focused expression. Show all hair, fingertips, and BOTH entire shoes. One doll alone, centered within a SQUARE image with generous empty transparent space on all sides. Same body proportions and toy catalog rendering. TRUE transparent background, no scene or floor, no shadows, halo, labels or logos.
prompts.fall: Create ONE sprite of this exact Hermione doll FALLING BACKWARDS, using the third cell of the reference strip as pose and identity reference. Preserve bushy chestnut hair, brown inset eyes, molded vinyl play-doll face and proportions, plain white shirt, charcoal cardigan, grey pleated skirt, dark grey knee socks, black Mary Jane shoes. Whole body tilted backwards toward LEFT, startled indignant expression, hands up, knees bent, shoes kicked forwards to RIGHT. Keep the same pose and character. CRUCIAL: fit the ENTIRE doll comfortably inside a square image with at least 12% transparent padding on every side, especially beyond the rightmost shoe and hair. No cropping whatsoever. Single doll only, no repeated figures. Toy catalog rendering, soft even light, true transparent background with clean alpha edges, no shadows/halos/gradients, no text, props or scenery.

notes: Pose strips use the canonical image for identity. Run was refined against its first generated strip; standalone push and fall replace edge-crowded cells. Manifests store anatomical anchors and explicit relative scales for larger standalone source canvases. Final WebPs are exported without manual pixel painting.
